schluss_frage: where do you think the bottom is?

szenen.text: One year ago the monthly MACD confirmed the Bitcoin bear market. Since then Bitcoin is {vom_hoch} from its high, now at {bis}.
szenen.text_ohne: One year ago the monthly MACD confirmed the Bitcoin bear market. It is still trending down.

szenen.text: The monthly MACD is still falling. It looks like it bottoms in the first half of 2027, and only crosses bullish in the second half.
Our view: the bottom comes in the first quarter of 2027. Most likely between thirty-five and forty-five thousand dollars. We'll see.
